description: Prices one same game parlay (2-10 legs from one pre-match event) at each requested bookmaker, using the bookmaker's own parlay price. Call get_sgp_legs first and pass its legId values; do not invent legs. Each bookmaker returns a status: ok (price, legsMultiplied, priceAdjustmentPct, links), not_combinable, leg_unavailable, suspended, unsupported, timeout or temporarily_unavailable, plus retryable, nextAction and reason. Branch on status and nextAction: change_legs (the legs do not combine there, replace one), remove_leg (drop the legs in legIds, or the slip exceeds that bookmaker's maxLegs), refresh_legs (call get_sgp_legs again, the line may have moved), retry, retry_later (wait retryAfter seconds when set) or choose_other_bookmaker. reason is a readable sentence to show the user; its wording can change, so never branch on it (on ok the only reason is redundant_leg, with the ignored legs in legIds). Never retry a result whose retryable is false. One bookmaker failing does not fail the request. A quote can take up to 8 seconds; at most 2 run at once per account. Read-only: it does not place bets. Included in all paid plans.

bookmakers.description: Comma-separated names from list_sgp_bookmakers, max 8 per request

eventId.description: Event ID from get_events or get_sgp_legs. Must be pre-match

legs.description: 2-10 legs from the same event. Normally pass legId from get_sgp_legs. The explicit market/hdp/label/side form is for callers that already hold an /v3/odds row and must match it exactly

expectedPrice.description: Optional single price you saw, decimal such as '1.91'. The leg is flagged priceMoved when it differs

hdp.description: Line as served on get_odds. Only when not using legId

label.description: Row label as served, 'Name (Stat)' for Player Props. Only when not using legId

market.description: Market name as served on get_odds. Only when not using legId

name: quote_sgp
title: Quote a same game parlay
